atomic_facts.fact: The subject's name is René Benko.
René Benko was born on 20 May 1977.
René Benko is the former Signa chief (former CEO of Signa).
René Benko is the founder of Signa Holding.
In October 2025, René Benko was sentenced to a prison term of two years.
The sentencing court was the Landesgericht Innsbruck.
The two-year prison term was unconditional (unbedingte Haftstrafe).
The Landesgericht Innsbruck imposed a two-year prison sentence on René Benko.
This two-year sentence was imposed in October 2025.
René Benko spent around nine months in pre-trial detention (Untersuchungshaft).
René Benko's first court appearance took place on 14 October 2025.
He remained in pre-trial detention until that first court appearance on 14 October 2025.
The OGH (Oberster Gerichtshof) intervened, overturning a partial acquittal and remanding the case to the Landesgericht for retrial.
After the OGH intervention, Benko's sentence was set at 30 months imprisonment, an increase over the original term.
The 30-month sentence is six months longer than the original two-year term.
